flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3001/app then Verify Available quota reads "$4,500.00".
Click "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" with a mouse click, as a user would.
Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers it; if the click does not reach it, the check fails.
Verify Available quota reads "$4,750.00" and Action status displays "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS".

remark: click: Clicking + Top Up Quota ($250) button
assert: Available quota reads "$4,750.00" and Action status displays "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCES

summary:
You asked to top up the quota by $250.
The “+ Top Up Quota ($250)” button was clicked.
The available quota increased from $4,500.00 to $4,750.00, and the page showed “QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS”.
one_liner: topped up quota on the app dashboard

available_quota_updated_check.human_description: Reading the available quota from the dashboard summary

action_status_displayed_check.human_description: Checking whether the action status is displayed
action_status_displayed_check.subject: Action status displaying "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS"
